translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: 1 Tesalonisiyen
book.title: 1 Tesalonisiyen Maktumne ta awalle taat Pool siirtu ɗo gee ku Tesalonik

content: Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, ni bal gedire pey nii goye bal kabarriko. Paa ko, ni ictu niyin taat ni ɗaktu keetini ɗo geeger ka Aten,
ho siŋte Timote gay, ni n̰aamiikoŋga. Ŋaar gina riy ɗo Buŋdi ta gaare Kabarre ta Gala ta Iisa Masi. Ni n̰aamiikoŋga-ak a ŋaako ɗeŋriŋko ho ŋaako iskiŋko ɗo imaanko.
Paa kat, yoo waanna rasiitɗo botiliy ɗo taaɓin taat gasiŋko-anta. Asaan kuŋ maaniiko oki iban kadar taaɓin ar taar-an yaate ase.
Wiktin taat ni goyiy iŋ kuŋko, ni kaawkoŋ ɗak ko biti. Kuŋ maaniiko tal iŋ odinko kadar kaaw-an as ɗo werti.

Ɗo saan taar-at ko, min nu bal gedire pey ƴoke kabarriko, nu n̰aamiig Timote a ŋaa iye kabarre ta imaanko, asaan nu gin kolaw a wal *Seetanne geciŋko ho ku rasit imaan. Ya ku rasta-ak gay, riy taat ni gintu ɗo werko-an uc usu.

Diŋ di Timote yeepinti min ɗo werko ho kabarre taat ŋa iyinti-an gala. Ŋa kaawinti ɗo bi ka imaanko, ɗo ele kaak ku elgiy ziŋkiko ho ŋa kaawinti a ku pakira samaane loni ho ku raka pey ŋaame iŋ nini ar taat nini oki rakiyo.
Ansii ko, gem kol siŋtay, iŋ taaɓin taat ni aawiyo ho iŋ pooce kaak gee poociini oki, kabarre taat a ku goy iŋ imaanko berinti gudurre.
Diŋ, goye ka duniiner gininti gala asaan ni dor kadar imaanko taat ɗo *Rabbiner, ku obit bombo.
Ni ibanno maman nii gedire dele barkin ɗo Buŋdi ɗo bi kaŋko ho galal okintiti taat ni aawiy ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi ɗo bi kaŋko.
Aando ƴiriyo, ni inda Buŋ iŋ gelbin rakki a ŋaani pile botol gi ɓaayiy ɗak ŋaame ho niiko ɓildiŋko a imaanko yaa ɓaa iŋ uŋti.
Ni inda Tatte Buŋ iŋ Rabbinte Iisa Masi yaani pile botol taat niiko ɓaawe.
Rabbin Iisa yaako gaayiŋko a ele kaak kuu elgiy ziŋkiko ho ku eliy gee okin̰co yaa ɓaa iŋ uŋji. Ni raka a kuu ele ziŋkiko ar kaak nin elgiiko.
Buŋ yaako ɗeŋriŋko ɗo imaanko. Ampaa kat, ɗo wiktin taat Rabbinte Iisa yaa yeepe iŋ geen̰ji okin̰co
, kuu gine *cawar ho bal oorne ɗo uŋji ka Tatte Buŋ.

footnotes.text: ‛geen̰ji okin̰co’ : Ŋuur ɗubal ku Buŋdi iŋ ŋuur kuuk aamin iŋ siŋ ku Iisa oki.
